correctness.rationale: The perfect weighted permutation structure makes every natural-basis isomorphism monomial; comparing squares forces u_(i+1)=2u_i+B_(i+k)−A_i modulo 3, with cyclic closure. For odd n the closure has one solution per rotation; for even n it has three lifts iff Δ(A)=(-1)^kΔ(B). This proves exactly the class count and subgroup counts for every n≥1, including n=2. In the unbalanced normal form even rotations are the only permissible ones; an explicit two-step lift g commutes with the order-3 diagonal d and satisfies g^h=d^(h−1), n=2h. Hence Aut is cyclic of order 3h, and extension 1→C3→C3h→Ch splits exactly when gcd(3,h)=1. Independently enumerated monomial maps and element orders in F4 multiplicative exponents for n≤8 and reconstructed all Git trees.
residual_risks: Enumeration for n≤8 is corroborative; proof of all n is the recurrence plus the group presentation, not finite exploration.
The group is that of F4-rational K-linear maps, not a group scheme over arbitrary extensions.
